# Locations {#locations}

We are **ethical hackers, penetration testers, reverse engineers and AI consultants** based in **Düsseldorf**. On-site in the Rhine-Ruhr region, along the Lower Rhine and across the Dutch and Belgian border; remote or on-site by arrangement everywhere else in the EU. Travel costs are quoted separately.

  const box = document.getElementById("map");
  const btn = document.getElementById("map-consent");
  let map = null, markers = {}, pending = null;

  function focus(id) {
    const m = markers[id];
    if (!m) return;
    map.setView(m.getLatLng(), 9);
    m.openPopup();
  }

  function load() {
    if (map || btn.disabled) return;
    btn.disabled = true;
    const css = document.createElement("link");
    css.rel = "stylesheet"; css.href = "/assets/leaflet/leaflet.css";
    document.head.appendChild(css);
    const js = document.createElement("script");
    js.src = "/assets/leaflet/leaflet.js";
    js.onload = function () {
      btn.remove();
      map = L.map(box, { scrollWheelZoom: false });
      L.tileLayer("https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
        maxZoom: 18,
        attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>'
      }).addTo(map);
      const pts = [];
      cities.forEach(function (c) {
        const m = L.circleMarker([c.lat, c.lon], {
          radius: c.home ? 10 : 6, weight: 2, color: "#1f5f99",
          fillColor: c.home ? "#e8590c" : "#2780e3", fillOpacity: 0.9
        }).addTo(map).bindPopup(c.name);
        markers[c.id] = m; pts.push([c.lat, c.lon]);
      });
      map.fitBounds(pts, { padding: [20, 20] });
      if (pending) focus(pending);
    };
    document.head.appendChild(js);
  }

  btn.addEventListener("click", load);
  document.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
    const a = ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest(".loc-city");
    if (!a) return;
    ev.preventDefault();
    box.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
    if (map) focus(a.dataset.city); else pending = a.dataset.city;
  });
})();
</script>

## Questions about locations {#faq}

### Are you available as a hacker or penetration tester in The Hague, Amsterdam or Rotterdam?

Yes. We are ethical hackers and security researchers based in Düsseldorf, about two hours from The Hague, Amsterdam and Rotterdam. We carry out penetration tests, security audits and vulnerability research for Dutch organisations remotely or on-site, always under a written scope and authorisation.

### Do you offer reverse engineering in Amsterdam, Brussels or elsewhere in the EU?

Yes. We reverse engineer binaries, firmware and undocumented protocols for clients across the EU, including Amsterdam, Brussels, Paris, Vienna and Copenhagen. Most reverse-engineering work is done remotely; on-site work is possible by arrangement.

### Which cities do you serve on-site?

On-site without long travel: all of North Rhine-Westphalia, including Düsseldorf, Cologne, Mönchengladbach, Krefeld, Viersen, Erkelenz, Wegberg, Neuss, Mettmann, Velbert, Solingen, Wuppertal, Leverkusen, Bergisch Gladbach, Bonn, Aachen, Duisburg, Essen, Bochum, Hagen, Dortmund, Münster and Bielefeld, plus Koblenz, the Dutch and Belgian border region (Roermond, Venlo, Maastricht, Eindhoven, Nijmegen), The Hague, Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Brussels and Antwerp. Elsewhere in Germany and the EU on-site by arrangement, with travel costs quoted separately.
